name: Controls Academy
value: Learn PLCs from zero: a real scan cycle, ladder logic on your phone, and machines in 3D that run your program.
imageAlt: Controls Academy on a phone: the PLC workbench with a motor start/stop station and its operator buttons

name: Critical Facilities Simulator
value: Run a data center's power and cooling, break it on purpose, and learn the safe way to bring it back.
imageAlt: Critical Facilities Simulator on a phone: the live plant from utility to chip, all systems normal, with run controls

name: Car Doctor
value: Describe the noise. It tells you what's likely wrong, whether it's safe to drive, and where to look.
imageAlt: Car Doctor on a phone: worn brake pads, Can I drive it?, and an engine bay with the front brakes lit in amber

name: Money Leak Finder
value: Finds the subscriptions, fees and small buys draining your pay. Everything stays on your phone.
imageAlt: Money Leak Finder on a phone: a pipe run with the biggest leak glowing, and $3,196 a year slipping away

name: Mill Dust Log
value: Combustible-dust rounds on a phone, with a plant-floor view of what's dusty and overdue. Works offline.
imageAlt: Mill Dust Log on a phone: a plant floor with zones colored by dust left and how overdue, and a legend
